# FireAlpaca

> FireAlpaca is a free, cross-platform digital painting software for Windows and Mac offering professional-grade brush tools, customizable materials, and creative features for digital artists.

FireAlpaca provides accessible digital art creation tools with both a free version and premium FireAlpaca SE option. The platform features an active creator community, brush libraries, and multilingual support across 9+ languages.

## Key Topics

- Digital Painting
- Free Software
- Cross-platform (Windows/Mac)
- Brush Customization
- Illustration Software
